titles.romaji: Monkey Punch Manga Katsudou Dai Shashin: Crime Mate Special
titles.native: モンキー・パンチ　漫画活動大写真

description:
Miki and Naomi are a pair of assassins and friends known as Crime Mate. They are tasked with dealing with a biological weapons and arms dealer named Ramon.

Crime Mate is a bonus 15 minute special that was made for the DVD release.
